items.title: Leslie Gourse interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: my father collected books, and my mother was always quoting Shakespeare.

ctx.x: Well it’s a big school out there, I think it’s Stanford University, and there was a school in the Midwest, either Earlham or Morrison. There were very few schools that would let you major in writing when I started college which was 1956. So I went into the School of Dramatic Arts as a playwriting major at Columbia at the age of 17, and you know I didn’t know how to write. I was good at dialogue although it didn’t really show up at that time. And I switched into the school of general studies during the semester I…
Well it was a good match then to put together your love of writing with your love of jazz and you’ve got quite a nice list of things you’ve done.
